description: v2.1.0 sections 6 and 22 — a base criminal offense expressed as typed fixed slots rather than a monolithic article unit.

statutory_refs.description: e.g. ['형법 제347조 제1항']. Open Question #13 (v2.1.0 section 25) — final article-to-doctrine mapping is a separate legal-review step; this field only records the reference, it does not carry legal effect.

elements.description: All seven fixed slots (section 6) are optional here — not every offense uses every slot (e.g. a conduct-only offense may omit causation/result). Absence means the slot is not part of this offense's constitutive elements, not that it is trivially satisfied.

element_modules.description: Section 7, Shared Element Modules — executable attachment, not a discoverability list. 2026-08-08 review: an earlier draft made this a bare array of bundle ids, leaving no way to say how a listed bundle's predicates attach to this offense's slots (op:ref-into-a-bundle was retracted as an element_expression leaf target — bundles are consumed via this mechanism or via a DerivedOffenseDef's COMPOSE, never as a bare expression leaf). Each entry now names a bundle and maps every one of that bundle's own leaf-refs to the slot it contributes to — identical mechanism to a COMPOSE component_ref with kind=bundle (derived_offense_def.schema.json). This offense's TRUE per-slot requirement is elements.<slot> combined with every element_modules entry's contribution to <slot>, not elements.<slot> alone — enforced by the Type checker (step 2), not this structural schema.

exports.description: Named export map for PROJECT (section 9.3), e.g. { "result": "injury_result" }. Keys are free-form export names, not restricted to fixed_slot_name, matching ExportedComponentDef.export_key.

qualifiers.description: QualifierDef ids that may legitimately QUALIFY this offense (e.g. embezzlement listing occupational_status). This is a menu of applicable qualifiers declared at the base offense, not an application — QUALIFY itself happens in DerivedOffenseDef.

participation_constraints.description: 2026-08-08 review: ParticipationPolicyDef (participation_policy_def.schema.json) is now a shared, offense-agnostic General Part definition of principal/co_principal/instigator/aider — most offenses need nothing here. This field exists only for the offense that genuinely deviates from the default (e.g. a personal/own-hand offense where co_principal-by-attribution does not apply, or an offense that attributes a narrower set of slots than the default policy). Absent or omitted means 'no deviation, use the shared policy as-is'.

disabled_modes.description: Modes from the shared ParticipationPolicyDef that do not apply to this offense at all (e.g. an own-hand offense excluding co_principal).

attributable_slots.description: Overrides the shared policy's co_principal.attributable_slots for this offense only, when this offense's ATTRIBUTE-eligible slots are narrower or wider than the default.
